objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the insecure deserialization weakness of a PHP SKU catalogue (Twig, SQLite) that talks to an internal SKU model service and read the flag in /flag.txt.
hints: Find the client-side data the server deserializes, and in which serialization format.
Check which properties of an upload the server validates, and where the stored file ends up.
